## Failure modes (fail-open to auto-correction)
- Missing term in registry → `DEF_RESOLVE_FAILED` and request only the missing registry entry or registry path.
- Hash mismatch → `DRIFT_DETECTED` + `AUTO_CORRECTION` to canonical, and declare the correction inline.
- Only unsafe actions justify fail-closed; definition resolution itself is not unsafe.

## BTS event payload (minimum fields)
- `event` (string)
- `term`
- `selected_version` (if any)
- `source_path` (if any)
- `expected_sha256` (if any)
- `actual_sha256` (if computed)
- `context`
- `status`
- `reason` (for failures/corrections)
